## Rationale and treatment

### F-05 Vehicle moves before activation - 20 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Fault injector
- **Likelihood 4:** Drivers start moving at any time
- **Impact 5:** Reboot of an ECU while driving is a safety hazard
- **Requirements:** SAF-03, SAF-04
- **Prevention:** Safety policy gate in ECU activate
- **Detection:** POSTPONED event with blocker codes
- **Recovery:** Stay STAGED and retry when safe
- **Negative tests:** FT-05, ACC-12
- **Residual risk:** Real vehicle-state signal authenticity not modelled
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-01 Firmware changed after signing - 20 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 4:** Attacker model allows modifying traffic; no key needed to alter bytes
- **Impact 5:** Malicious code on an ECU defeats the project claim and may reach actuators
- **Requirements:** SR-02, SR-03
- **Prevention:** SHA-256 check at gateway and again at ECU before staging
- **Detection:** DIGEST_MISMATCH / BAD_SIGNATURE audit event with correlation ID
- **Recovery:** No state change; retry from repository
- **Negative tests:** AT-01, AT-08, AT-18
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-02 Release creator approves their own release - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Malicious operator
- **Likelihood 3:** Small teams often hold both roles
- **Impact 5:** Unreviewed firmware gets signed and offered
- **Requirements:** SR-18, SR-15
- **Prevention:** Approver must differ from creator, checked by backend and again by signing service
- **Detection:** DENIED audit event; REFUSED_SELF_APPROVAL in key usage log
- **Recovery:** Release stays DRAFT
- **Negative tests:** ACC-25, AT-26
- **Residual risk:** Two colluding insiders can still approve each other's releases
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-03 Artifact replaced in backend object storage after signing - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised online service
- **Likelihood 3:** Object storage is online and broadly accessible
- **Impact 5:** Malicious firmware offered to the whole fleet
- **Requirements:** SR-01, SR-02, SR-03
- **Prevention:** Signed digest and length checked at gateway and again at ECU
- **Detection:** DIGEST_MISMATCH vehicle event and REJECTED assignment, same correlation ID
- **Recovery:** Nothing staged; restore the artifact from the release record
- **Negative tests:** AT-18
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-09 Private key or credential committed to source control - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Malicious operator
- **Likelihood 3:** A common developer mistake, made permanent by git history
- **Impact 5:** Any reader of the repository can sign firmware
- **Requirements:** SR-10
- **Prevention:** Keys generated in memory or stored encrypted outside the tree; .gitignore for key files
- **Detection:** scan_secrets in run_all and QT-01
- **Recovery:** Revoke the key through a new key set and rewrite history
- **Negative tests:** QT-01, AT-27
- **Residual risk:** Pattern-based scan cannot find every secret format
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### F-03 Power fails during staging or commit - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Fault injector
- **Likelihood 3:** Vehicles lose power during updates
- **Impact 5:** Unbootable ECU
- **Requirements:** SAF-06, SAF-08, SAF-01
- **Prevention:** Inactive-slot writes; temp file + atomic rename; intent record
- **Detection:** DISCARDED_PARTIAL_STAGING event on restart
- **Recovery:** Recovery returns to IDLE or STAGED with old slot bootable
- **Negative tests:** FT-03, ACC-15
- **Residual risk:** Real flash wear and partial-sector writes not modelled
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### F-04 New image fails health confirmation - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Fault injector
- **Likelihood 3:** Bad builds ship
- **Impact 5:** ECU stuck on broken firmware
- **Requirements:** SAF-05, FR-10
- **Prevention:** Confirmed slot kept until positive health
- **Detection:** ROLLED_BACK event with cause
- **Recovery:** Automatic rollback; boot-attempt limit
- **Negative tests:** FT-04, ACC-14
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-02 Signature by unknown or revoked key - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Unauthorized signer
- **Likelihood 3:** Rogue keys are cheap to generate; revocation lists can lag
- **Impact 5:** Accepting attacker metadata gives full firmware control
- **Requirements:** SR-03, SR-04
- **Prevention:** Trusted key set and revoked key_id list
- **Detection:** UNTRUSTED_KEY / BAD_SIGNATURE event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-02, AT-25
- **Residual risk:** Trusted-key update procedure is S3 key-lifecycle work
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-04 Older valid firmware offered (downgrade) - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 3:** Old signed releases remain valid signatures forever
- **Impact 5:** Reintroduces known vulnerabilities
- **Requirements:** SR-06
- **Prevention:** trusted_min_version checked at gateway and ECU; raised only on confirmation
- **Detection:** ROLLBACK_REJECTED event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-04
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### V-05 Spoofed or invalid vehicle safety inputs - 15 Critical

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised ECU
- **Likelihood 3:** Sensor messages are easy to forge or garble
- **Impact 5:** Activation while moving
- **Requirements:** SAF-03, SAF-04
- **Prevention:** Invalid or non-finite inputs treated as unsafe
- **Detection:** POSTPONED event with blocker codes
- **Recovery:** Stay STAGED
- **Negative tests:** AT-16
- **Residual risk:** Authenticity of real sensor inputs not modelled
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-01 API caller spoofs an identity with a stolen or forged credential - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 3:** Credentials leak through laptops and CI logs; forging needs no key
- **Impact 4:** Attacker acts as an operator or as another vehicle
- **Requirements:** SR-08
- **Prevention:** Token authentication; vehicle identity bound to its vehicle_id
- **Detection:** UNAUTHENTICATED and DENIED audit events
- **Recovery:** Revoke the credential; no state change on rejection
- **Negative tests:** AT-20, AT-31
- **Residual risk:** A stolen valid token works until revoked; prototype tokens have no expiry or rotation
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-04 Campaign or assignment records modified in the database - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised online service
- **Likelihood 3:** Database credentials are a frequent target
- **Impact 4:** Vehicles retargeted to other versions or ECUs
- **Requirements:** SR-03, SR-07, SR-15
- **Prevention:** Offers are signed from approved release records; gateway verifies every signed field
- **Detection:** BAD_SIGNATURE vehicle event
- **Recovery:** Re-issue offers from release records
- **Negative tests:** AT-23
- **Residual risk:** An attacker who controls both the database and the online signing path can sign altered content; offline image signing is a Phase 3 decision
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-05 Audit evidence modified or deleted - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Malicious operator
- **Likelihood 3:** Insiders have motive to hide actions
- **Impact 4:** Unauthorized actions cannot be proven; research evidence loses credibility
- **Requirements:** SR-14, SR-09
- **Prevention:** Append-only API and SHA-256 hash chain
- **Detection:** verify() reports the first broken sequence; head hash compared with exported anchor
- **Recovery:** Restore from the anchored copy
- **Negative tests:** ACC-27, AT-28
- **Residual risk:** A full chain rebuild is detected only if the anchor is stored where the attacker cannot write
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-07 Sensitive data disclosed in error responses or logs - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 3:** Stack traces and debug messages leak by default in web frameworks
- **Impact 4:** Credential or key exposure leads to wider compromise
- **Requirements:** SR-11, NFR-05, US-02
- **Prevention:** Fixed error messages; generic INTERNAL handler; audit field denylist
- **Detection:** Secret scan of evidence and logs
- **Recovery:** Rotate any exposed credential
- **Negative tests:** AT-21, QT-02
- **Residual risk:** Third-party library logs outside the prototype are not scanned
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-08 Event reports replayed or duplicated - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 4:** Gateways retry on timeouts; captured reports are easy to resend
- **Impact 3:** Assignment state wrong; campaign metrics false
- **Requirements:** FR-12, FR-13
- **Prevention:** event_id idempotency, metadata_version binding and transition table
- **Detection:** CONFLICT codes in audit
- **Recovery:** Original result returned; no state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-30
- **Residual risk:** Event reports are authenticated by token only, not signed by the vehicle key
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-03 Previously valid metadata replayed - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 3:** Captured metadata is easy to resend
- **Impact 4:** Can re-push a superseded image or block progress
- **Requirements:** SR-07
- **Prevention:** Monotonic metadata_version per ECU stored durably
- **Detection:** REPLAYED_METADATA event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-03
- **Residual risk:** Counter reset on gateway storage wipe not covered
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-05 Artifact targets another ECU or hardware revision - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 3:** Valid images for other ECUs exist and are signed
- **Impact 4:** Wrong image can brick the ECU
- **Requirements:** SR-05
- **Prevention:** ecu_id + hardware_id binding at gateway and ECU
- **Detection:** WRONG_TARGET event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-05
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-08 Download truncated oversized or endless - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 4:** Trivial to cut or pad a stream
- **Impact 3:** Memory or flash exhaustion; partial image
- **Requirements:** SR-12, SR-02
- **Prevention:** Declared-length cap before download; byte cap while reading; exact length check
- **Detection:** ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE / LENGTH_MISMATCH event
- **Recovery:** No state change; retry
- **Negative tests:** AT-08, AT-17
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-10 Operator performs an unauthorized privileged action - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Malicious operator
- **Likelihood 3:** Operators hold real credentials; misconfigured roles are a common failure
- **Impact 4:** An unapproved campaign or release could reach vehicles
- **Requirements:** SR-08, SR-09, SR-18
- **Prevention:** Authorization matrix checked before every action
- **Detection:** DENIED audit event with actor and correlation ID
- **Recovery:** No state change; transaction rolled back
- **Negative tests:** AT-10, AT-22
- **Residual risk:** An insider acting inside their own role is detected (audit) but not prevented
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-11 Vehicle version manifest modified - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 3:** Manifest crosses the hostile network
- **Impact 4:** Backend targets wrong versions or misses a failed update
- **Requirements:** FR-08, SR-13, SR-20
- **Prevention:** Manifest signed with vehicle key
- **Detection:** BAD_SIGNATURE at backend
- **Recovery:** Backend rejects the manifest and keeps the last accepted inventory
- **Negative tests:** AT-11, AT-19
- **Residual risk:** Vehicle key protection is simulated only
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### V-03 Flash corruption of the staged image - 12 High

- **Attacker / source:** Fault injector
- **Likelihood 3:** Bit flips and wear occur
- **Impact 4:** Corrupt image activated
- **Requirements:** SAF-07
- **Prevention:** Digest re-check before slot switch
- **Detection:** STORAGE_ERROR event and REJECTED state
- **Recovery:** Old slot stays active; next update re-stages
- **Negative tests:** AT-14
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### F-01 Network disconnects during download - 10 High

- **Attacker / source:** Fault injector
- **Likelihood 5:** Mobile links drop often
- **Impact 2:** Delay only if handled
- **Requirements:** FR-03, FR-11, SAF-02
- **Prevention:** Nothing staged until full verified download
- **Detection:** NETWORK_ERROR event
- **Recovery:** Restart download from zero; replay counter not advanced
- **Negative tests:** FT-01
- **Residual risk:** Resume-from-offset not implemented
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### K-01 Release key used to sign an unapproved release - 10 High

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised online service
- **Likelihood 2:** Needs access to the signing interface
- **Impact 5:** Arbitrary firmware signed with a trusted key
- **Requirements:** SR-15, SR-18
- **Prevention:** Signing service checks approval state, separation of duties and payload equality
- **Detection:** Refusals in key usage log
- **Recovery:** Revoke the key (K-03)
- **Negative tests:** AT-26
- **Residual risk:** The signing service trusts the approval record it is given; production needs approver signatures or threshold signing
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### K-02 Trusted key set replaced or rolled back - 10 High

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 2:** Key set updates cross the hostile network
- **Impact 5:** Attacker keys become trusted on the vehicle
- **Requirements:** SR-16
- **Prevention:** Root signature, monotonic version and expiry on every key set
- **Detection:** UNTRUSTED_KEY / BAD_SIGNATURE / REPLAYED_METADATA rejection
- **Recovery:** Vehicle keeps its current key set
- **Negative tests:** ACC-30, AT-24
- **Residual risk:** Root key compromise and root rotation are out of scope (ASM-07)
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### K-03 Release signing key compromised - 10 High

- **Attacker / source:** Unauthorized signer
- **Likelihood 2:** Online keys are exposed to server compromise
- **Impact 5:** Attacker metadata verifies until the key is revoked
- **Requirements:** SR-04, SR-16
- **Prevention:** Revocation by publishing a higher key set version
- **Detection:** Unexpected key_id or usage-log mismatch
- **Recovery:** Revoke and rotate; re-sign pending offers with the new key
- **Negative tests:** AT-25
- **Residual risk:** Window between compromise and revocation; offline vehicles keep the old set
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### V-01 Malicious CAN peer sends unsolicited activation or confirmation - 10 High

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised ECU
- **Likelihood 2:** Requires a foothold on the vehicle network
- **Impact 5:** Could commit an untested image
- **Requirements:** SAF-10
- **Prevention:** State machine accepts commands only in matching state
- **Detection:** INVALID_STATE event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-13
- **Residual risk:** Gateway-to-ECU message authentication not modelled (in-process calls); architecture-phase decision needed
- **Status:** Draft - needs supervisor decision

### V-04 Boot manipulation of the newly activated image - 10 High

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised ECU
- **Likelihood 2:** Needs write access to inactive storage
- **Impact 5:** Unverified code runs
- **Requirements:** SAF-09, SAF-05
- **Prevention:** Digest check at boot while INSTALLED
- **Detection:** ROLLED_BACK cause ACTIVE_IMAGE_INTEGRITY
- **Recovery:** Automatic rollback
- **Negative tests:** AT-15
- **Residual risk:** Secure boot of the confirmed image is out of scope
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### F-02 Gateway terminates during state transition - 9 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Fault injector
- **Likelihood 3:** Crashes and resets happen
- **Impact 3:** Gateway and ECU bookkeeping could disagree
- **Requirements:** FR-11
- **Prevention:** Atomic writes; ECU stage is idempotent
- **Detection:** Mismatch visible in manifest
- **Recovery:** Retry reconciles to ALREADY_APPLIED
- **Negative tests:** FT-02
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### B-06 API resource exhaustion through oversized uploads - 8 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 4:** Large bodies cost nothing to send
- **Impact 2:** Backend memory or storage exhausted; campaigns delayed
- **Requirements:** SR-19
- **Prevention:** Content-Length and body size limit before storage
- **Detection:** PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE audit event
- **Recovery:** Request dropped
- **Negative tests:** AT-29
- **Residual risk:** No request-rate limiting in the prototype
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### K-04 Key used outside its authorized role - 8 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Unauthorized signer
- **Likelihood 2:** Shared keys across roles are a common shortcut
- **Impact 4:** A vehicle or root key could authorize firmware
- **Requirements:** SR-17
- **Prevention:** One role per key; gateway trusts release-role keys only
- **Detection:** WRONG_KEY_ROLE refusal; UNTRUSTED_KEY at gateway
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-26
- **Residual risk:** None at simulation level
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-06 Metadata from different campaigns mixed - 8 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised online service
- **Likelihood 2:** Needs control of the instruction channel
- **Impact 4:** Inconsistent multi-ECU versions
- **Requirements:** SR-07
- **Prevention:** All envelopes checked against bundle campaign before any download
- **Detection:** INCONSISTENT_METADATA event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-06, AT-23
- **Residual risk:** Cross-ECU dependency rules deferred (T-12)
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-09 Download intentionally slowed - 8 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 4:** Slow-drip is trivial
- **Impact 2:** Update delayed; gateway resources held
- **Requirements:** NFR-04
- **Prevention:** Stall and total timeouts
- **Detection:** DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT event
- **Recovery:** No state change; retry
- **Negative tests:** AT-09
- **Residual risk:** Real socket timeouts needed in implementation
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-07 Expired metadata after clock manipulation - 6 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Network attacker
- **Likelihood 2:** Requires control of the time source
- **Impact 3:** Stale but still signed instructions accepted
- **Requirements:** SR-07
- **Prevention:** expires_at compared to trusted clock
- **Detection:** EXPIRED_METADATA event
- **Recovery:** No state change
- **Negative tests:** AT-07
- **Residual risk:** Secure-time source is an assumption (A-TIME) owned by S3
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### T-12 Dependency cycle declared across ECU versions - 6 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Malicious operator
- **Likelihood 2:** Needs operator access or a configuration mistake
- **Impact 3:** Campaign can never complete; vehicles stay on mixed versions
- **Requirements:** FR-14
- **Prevention:** Topological ordering of campaign ECUs at creation
- **Detection:** VALIDATION_FAILED DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with diagnostic
- **Recovery:** Campaign not created
- **Negative tests:** AT-12
- **Residual risk:** Cross-campaign dependencies are not modelled
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop

### V-02 Compromised ECU reports false version or state - 6 Medium

- **Attacker / source:** Compromised ECU
- **Likelihood 2:** Requires ECU compromise
- **Impact 3:** Backend believes a stale ECU is updated
- **Requirements:** FR-08, SR-20
- **Prevention:** Gateway reports only state read from ECU store
- **Detection:** Backend rejects incomplete or inconsistent manifests (MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE / MANIFEST_INCONSISTENT)
- **Recovery:** Re-run campaign for the ECU
- **Negative tests:** AT-19
- **Residual risk:** Accepted for this phase; ECU attestation out of scope
- **Status:** Draft - awaiting team scoring workshop
